03What It IsOVERVIEW▶

A Claude skill that makes a small web tool, the AI Prompt Maker, in the same locked Vibe Coding design as Swami's dashboards. The page has two parts: an Input form with editable fields, and a live Output panel that shows the fields as plain text.

Swami names the fields and their defaults (or reuses his standard set: subject, topic, issue, date, student, helper, AI used, websites, and content). Claude fills them into a prebuilt template, sets the header text, and publishes the page. All the interaction logic is already built into the template, so Claude never rewrites it.

Why it mattersPasting a situation into an AI chat works best when it is complete, tidy, and plain text. A fill-in form keeps every case (a student, a client, someone Swami is helping) in the same shape, and the plain ASCII output pastes cleanly into any AI.
04What It DoesOVERVIEW▶
  • Input formOne row per field: an editable field name (the mono cyan box) joined to its value. Long text gets a big text box and lists get one box per entry.
  • Live outputShows the text as you type, as key: value lines, lists as indented - items, and long text as a block. Empty fields are left out.
  • Plain ASCIIConverts smart quotes, dashes, ellipses, accents, and symbols to plain characters, so the text pastes cleanly anywhere.
  • Edit fieldsRename a field, delete it with ✕, add one with + Add field, and drag the ⠿ handle to reorder.
  • Single or listThe [ ] / [≣] toggle switches a field between one value and a list, splitting or joining on commas.
  • Copy and downloadCopies the text to the clipboard, or saves it as a .txt file named after the subject field, from the toolbar or the Output panel.
  • Reset with undoOne click restores the default fields, with a 4-second Undo; no pop-up confirmations, because the artifact frame blocks them.
  • Default field setShips with subject, topic, issue, date (today), student/client/other, teacher/consultant/helper (Swami), AI used, websites (a list), and content/text (long text).
  • Locked designSame palette, fonts, kicker, and footer as vibe-dashboard; both sections start collapsed.

08Capabilities and LimitationsSCOPE▶
  • Any field setWorks for any case you want to describe to an AI: students, clients, support requests, projects.
  • Edit in placeFields can be renamed, added, removed, reordered, and switched between single and list while you work.
  • Clean textThe output is plain ASCII, so it never brings odd characters into a prompt.
  • Works offlineSaved as a .html file, it works from disk with a normal browser download.
  • No memoryNothing is saved between visits; reloading the page brings back the defaults. Copy or download before closing.
  • Text onlyOutput is plain key: value text; there is no JSON or other format switch.
  • No importThere is no way to load a saved .txt back into the form.
  • Download permissionOn the published page, Download needs the downloads permission; without it, use Copy.

11GotchasGOTCHAS▶
  • Reload clears itThe form keeps no browser storage, by design. Reloading or closing the page loses what you typed.
  • No pop-upsThe artifact frame blocks confirm and alert dialogs, so Reset uses the in-button Undo instead. Never add pop-ups back.
  • Download blockedA published page can't start a download by itself. Without the downloads permission the button says to use Copy.
  • Odd charactersCharacters with no plain equivalent (emoji, other scripts) become ? in the output.
  • Collapsed at startBoth sections start collapsed; click Input to begin.
  • List toggleSwitching a list back to a single value joins its entries with commas; switching again splits on commas.
12Other RequirementsREFERENCE▶
  • ArtifactsPublishing needs Claude's artifacts, plus the downloads permission for the Download button.
  • BrowserAny current browser on macOS or on Windows 10 or 11.
  • ClipboardCopy uses the browser clipboard; if the browser blocks it, the page falls back to an older copy method.
